EDGE-016.body:
Out of something? These swaps keep the pancakes fluffy:

- No buttermilk: stir 1 tablespoon of lemon juice or white vinegar into 1 cup of regular milk and let it sit for 5 minutes. Plain yogurt thinned with a splash of milk also works.
- No eggs: use a flax egg (1 tablespoon ground flaxseed + 3 tablespoons water, rested 5 minutes) per egg, or 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce per egg.
- Flour: a 1:1 gluten-free baking blend works cup-for-cup. Or swap half the all-purpose flour for whole wheat - add an extra tablespoon of milk, as whole wheat drinks more liquid.
- No butter: melted coconut oil or any neutral oil, same amount.
- No baking powder: 1/4 teaspoon baking soda plus 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar per teaspoon of baking powder.
- Sugar: maple syrup or honey, 3/4 cup per cup of sugar, and reduce the other liquid slightly.
